competences.description: Attacks the enemy to increase its chances of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Spooky ghosts appear from the bag to attack all enemies 2 times. The first hit removes 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance, and the second hit decreases the Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

competences.description: Prevents the enemy from removing harmful effects with an 80% chance for 1 turn if you attack the enemy under harmful effects, and silences for 1 turn with a 30% chance if you attack the enemy with no harmful effects. In addition, increases your Attack Bar by 20% whenever the enemy is granted with harmful effects. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: When enemy is granted with harmful effects

effets.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)
effets.note: if you attack the enemy with no harmful effects
